Privacy Policy

Application: Burak YouTube Metadata · Last updated: 5 October 2026

"Burak YouTube Metadata" is a personal tool used only by its developer, Burak Akgül, to monitor and manage his own YouTube channel. It is not offered to the public and has no other users.

What data the app accesses

With the owner's explicit consent through Google OAuth, the app accesses data of the owner's own YouTube channel only: video metadata (titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails) and channel analytics (views, impressions, watch time and similar reports).

How the data is used

The data is used solely to track the performance of the owner's channel and to help manage its video metadata. It is never used for advertising, profiling or any other purpose.

Storage and sharing

All data and OAuth tokens are stored on a private server controlled by the owner. The data is not sold, shared, transferred or disclosed to any third party.

Google API Services

The app's use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Revoking access and deleting data

Access can be revoked at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions. Stored data can be deleted on request or by the owner at any time.

Contact

Gizlilik Politikası (Türkçe özet)

"Burak YouTube Metadata", yalnızca geliştiricisi Burak Akgül'ün kendi YouTube kanalını izlemek ve yönetmek için kullandığı kişisel bir araçtır. Yalnızca kendi kanalının video bilgileri ve analitik verilerine, kendi izniyle Google OAuth üzerinden erişir. Veriler yalnızca sahibine ait özel bir sunucuda saklanır; hiçbir üçüncü tarafla paylaşılmaz, satılmaz ve reklam amacıyla kullanılmaz. Erişim, Google hesap izinleri sayfasından istenildiği zaman kaldırılabilir.
